description: Repository invitation metadata, not approval or execution/publication authority. Raw input must be strict UTF-8 JSON of at most 16384 bytes without duplicate keys.

items.description: Nonblank means containing a character outside the fixed Unicode White_Space set: U+0009–000D, U+0020, U+0085, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000–200A, U+2028–2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000. U+FEFF is not whitespace. C0 and DEL are forbidden.
